name: China City Infrastructure Group Limited
summary: China City Infrastructure Group Limited is an investment holding company based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, operating mainly in China since 2002, and called China Water Property Group Limited before December 2014. It develops real estate such as residential complexes, malls, offices and hotels, invests in and leases property, and provides property management and tourism services. It runs the 231-room Future City Hotel for business guests.
